Theorem B (parts not tied to V)

Figure 1 caption (P10s_main.tex:136-142; "a solution would be a crossing" = sec_2_2_xia_eq + thm_B_xia_iff)

Table 4 caption (added v1.90): of the five values only n = 8, 80 make p prime
